Test Case Title: Full coverage prints no coverage finding
Preconditions: A temp folder holding a spec with ids AC-1, AC-2, BR-1 and an acceptance-tests.csv whose rows reference all three
Test Steps:
1. Run: python3 validate_spec.py <tmp>/0-spec.md <tmp>
2. Read the printed output
3. Read the exit code (echo $?)
Test Data: Spec ids: AC-1, AC-2, BR-1; CSV Source Refs: AC-1, AC-2, BR-1
